title: Vampire Vape Tropical Mango Paradise 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Mango Paradise Nic Salt from Vampire Vape’s Tropical collection brings a wave of tropical sunshine to your vape with a vibrant trio of ripe Mango, zesty Blood Orange and juicy Pineapple. The Mango offers a bright, juicy base that’s soft and rounded, while the Blood Orange adds a tart citrus burst with just a hint of bitter sweetness. Pineapple cuts through with its bright, juicy tang to keep the blend tasting rich and full of sunshine. Formulated with nicotine salts, this e-liquid provides faster-acting nicotine relief with a smoother inhale, making it ideal for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping using pod kits and starter devices. Available in 10mg and 20mg strengths to suit a range of preferences. Vampire Vape e-liquids are made in the UK and are renowned for their quality and creativity. The Tropical collection brings some exotic sunshine to their award-winning range. Also available in Freebase, Shortfill and Concentrate formats.
